basics.name: Alex Rivera
basics.label: Full Stack Developer
basics.summary: I design and build fast, scalable and accessible digital products. 8+ years turning complex ideas into software people enjoy using. I'm a Full Stack developer with 8+ years of experience building web applications for startups and tech companies. I specialize in the TypeScript ecosystem: React and Next.js interfaces, Node.js APIs and AWS infrastructure. I'm obsessed with quality: clean code, tests you can trust, measurable performance and experiences that are accessible to everyone. I enjoy designing a system's architecture as much as polishing the last detail of an animation. Outside work I contribute to open source, write about web development and mentor people taking their first steps in programming.
